summary: Verified fix for 'useLocalSearchParams is not defined' runtime error in /app/frontend/app/payment-form.tsx. All 3 payment-form entry paths (Home tile-payments, btn-add-payment-from-supplier, edit-mode via tl-payment-*) open without any ReferenceError. Edit-mode correctly shows 'Edit Payment' title with pre-filled amount (42.5) and Delete Payment button. Regression flows (btn-add-bill, btn-add-supplier, tile-sales, tile-inventory, Reports tab, voice-fab modal) all render successfully. Zero ReferenceError/'is not defined' console errors captured across all flows (only benign React-Native-Web deprecation warnings for shadow*/pointerEvents which are pre-existing framework noise, not blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking, but should be migrated. Likely from shared UI components (Card etc.). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/UI/*

action_items: None for the reported bug — fix is verified working.
Optional cleanup: migrate remaining shadow* props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents in shared UI components to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: payment-form.tsx useEffect has empty dependency array but references editId & supplierId inside — acceptable here because it's an init-once pattern, but consider adding [editId] to be explicit.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_Supplier and 1 TEST_seed payment via API to exercise edit-mode; both DELETED after test. Final state: suppliers=[], payments=[].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment-form entry-route regressions covered. Bottom-tab testIDs: tab-home, tab-bills, tab-suppliers, tab-reports, tab-settings. Supplier rows: data-testid='supplier-<uuid>'. Timeline rows: 'tl-<kind>-<id>'. Home tiles: 'tile-<key>' (payments/suppliers/sales/inventory). Close buttons follow pattern btn-close-<form>. voice-fab lives on Home screen. If seeding is needed, POST /api/suppliers then /api/payments with type=supplier_payment.
rca_of_issue: RCA (confirmed): Original error 'useLocalSearchParams is not defined' was caused by /app/frontend/app/payment-form.tsx importing only `useRouter` from 'expo-router' on line 5 while the component body (line 16) used `useLocalSearchParams<{id?: string}>()`. Fix applied by main agent: added `useLocalSearchParams` to the import statement. Verified in current source: line 5 reads `import { useRouter, useLocalSearchParams } from "expo-router";`. All three navigation entry paths that mount payment-form.tsx now load cleanly with no console ReferenceError.
